about: Negatives of the seal v2 layer (core §5.2 SEALED-2C), each a whole envelope built like SEALED-2A with one change, with the seal reason it fails with and the step: parse = ParseOuter refuses it (no ack_key), open = Open refuses it after layer 1 (AckKeyOf true), sig = Open accepts it and the signature does not verify under the sender's key. Inner keys 0 and 30 are added after signing; every other envelope is signed as it is sent. The second-layer cases seal to recipient_ix, the recipient's interaction key in the base interaction with the sender (seed role recipient-ix): stripping the second layer, sealing it again with another enc2, and moving a single-layer message under it keep the layer-1 ephemeral key of "ok, two layers", so only the second-layer keys of the preimage differ and the signature fails; a key the recipient no longer holds, a changed layer-2 byte, a key of another interaction or peer, and an rk of suite 2 fail in Open.
seeds: seed(role) = SHA-256("anet-golden/v016/SEALED-2C/<role>"); Ed25519 keys are the seeds, X25519 keys are DeriveKeyPair(seed) of RFC 9180 suite 1
